source.name: CIHOF class-country supplied nationality, heritage, and community completions
source.note: Nationality/heritage working metadata normalized from the supplied class-countries document. These records can override generated extractor guesses, but remain inferred until copied into approvedCountryTags during curator review. Community groupings are stored separately in curated metadata.

reviewGuidance.inferredCountryTags: Working nationality/heritage completions from class-countries.docx. Review before copying into approvedCountryTags in cihof_curated_metadata.json.
reviewGuidance.overrideGeneratedCountryTags: When true, replace generated or earlier inferred labels because the attachment supplied a more direct nationality/heritage label or an explicit no-nationality community case.
reviewGuidance.confidence: All records in this file are inferred and require curator review before final museum labeling.
reviewGuidance.evidenceNote: Short rationale naming the supplied heritage/community label and the nationality/heritage tags mapped from it.
